file_id: Rajkumar vs State Of Uttarakhand on 26 May, 2015

sentences.text: Rajkumar vs State Of Uttarakhand on 26 May, 2015
Bench: Sudhanshu Dhulia CRMA No. 841 of 2015 IN CRLR No. 133 of 2015 Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. Manish Arora, Advocate, present for the revisionist.

Mr. M.A. Khan, learned Deputy Advocate General, with Mr. Rakesh Kunwar, learned Brief Holder,
present for the State.

The revisionist has been convicted under Section 7(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,
and has been sentenced under Section 16(1)(a)(i) for six months simple imprisonment with a fine of `1000.00(Rupees one thousand only), with the default stipulation.
Thereafter, the appeal of the revisionist was also rejected vide judgment and order dated 21.04.2015.
Heard learned counsel for the parties on bail application.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, let the revisionist be released on interim bail in connection with the complaint Case No. 27 of 2005, under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 Police Station Kankhal, District Haridwar, on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties of the equal amount to the satisfaction of the Magistrate/court concerned.
